headline: Shandoka goes before Planning & Zoning on Thursday, October 22
blurb: P&Z holds the public hearing on the Shandoka Lot Preliminary PUD: an 804-space parking structure (890 at build-out), 53 homes, a transit center, a food bank and childcare on Town-owned Lot L. Staff recommend approval, with the garage allowed up to 46 feet against a 40-foot limit. Written comment goes to kclothier@telluride.gov before 9 a.m. Thursday.
